headline: Datacenter demand drives accelerating growth, record profit
summary_short: Coherent's fiscal Q3 2026 (quarter ended March 31, 2026) revenue rose to $1.81B (+20.5% y/y, +7.1% q/q), and GAAP diluted EPS reached $0.97, swinging from a $0.11 per-share loss a year ago as datacenter and communications demand accelerated.
summary_long: Datacenter & Communications revenue grew 40.6% y/y to $1.36B on exceptionally strong AI-datacenter demand, while Industrial fell 16.1% y/y to $444M, partially offsetting the gain. GAAP gross margin expanded 243bps y/y to 37.7% (non-GAAP +105bps to 39.6%), and GAAP operating income nearly tripled y/y to $201M. Net income attributable to Coherent surged to $191M from $16M a year ago, aided by the conversion of Series B preferred stock that eliminated its dividend drag on EPS. Cash and equivalents rose to $1.59B (+84% q/q) after a $2.0B common-share issuance and refinancing that paid down existing debt while raising new Term A/B facilities. For fiscal Q4 2026, Coherent guides revenue of $1.91B-$2.05B and non-GAAP EPS of $1.52-$1.72.

drivers.explanation: CEO cited exceptionally strong demand across the datacenter and communications businesses as AI datacenter infrastructure scales, prompting rapid capacity expansion.
Growth was concentrated in Datacenter & Communications (+40.6% y/y to $1.36B); Industrial revenue fell 16.1% y/y to $444M, partially offsetting.
CFO attributed the EPS and earnings increase to significant revenue growth together with gross margin expansion.
